## FAQs

# Frequently Asked Questions

### Membership Accounts

How do I build points?


Points are generated automatically and stored in your account whenever you buy and sell. So the more you buy/sell the more points you build.


Can I get points if I recommend a friend?


Sure! Just get your friends to register an account and mention your name in the “where did you hear about us?" section and when they make a sale/purchase. We will give you 50 free points.


Can I collect points on buying and selling as well?


Absolutely! Just register an account with us and points will get added to your account every time you buy or sell automatically.


Do you need Identification to create my account?


Identity checks are mandatory so that we can confirm who you are and keep your account safe when buying/selling with us.


Can I redeem my points for cash?


No but points can be used to level up through the different membership tiers to access great benefits and discounts to save you money.


How does the points system work?


You earn 1 point for every £1 you spend and ½ a point for every £1 when you sell. As you collect more and more points you progress through the different membership tiers and unlock discounts and benefits at each stage.


### Payment Options

What payment options do you accept?


We accept a range of payment methods, including debit, credit cards and bank transfer. Please note due to the strict requirements of gold bullion there may be Identification and address proof required.


Are there any payment limits when paying by debit card?


Each transaction is assessed on a case-by-case basis and subject to the merits of the transaction a limit will be communicated to you subject to our verification checks.


### Buying From Us

Do You Ship Outside the UK?


Unfortunately, we do not currently deliver outside the UK. We deliver to UK mainland addresses only.


How long does delivery take?


It can be as early as tomorrow by selecting next day special delivery or alternatively our standard delivery takes between 2-5 Working days.


Can I cancel my order once submitted?


As the goods we sell and provide are dependent on fluctuations in the market price, under the Financial Services Regulations 2004 there is no statutory right to cancel. Cancelled orders will incur a cancellation fee of £100 as well as any differences in the commodity price for the product(s) since the date of purchase.


Can I make a change to my order once submitted?


It may be possible to make a change for a similar product but it is dependent on price and availability. Contact our team as soon as possible and we will do our best to help.


If I place an order online will my parcel be insured?


All items are fully insured by us, and insurance is covered up until they are successfully delivered at your address.


### Selling To Us

Do you buy diamonds?


No.


Do you buy electronic scraps?


No.


What if my items contain parts which are not precious metal e.g. stones?


Not to worry, all your items will be re-inspected once we receive them so if there are any non-precious containing items it will be recalculated to reflect the correct value and a member of our team will of course contact you with the updated price before proceeding.
